title: Open Forge workspace settings
description: Authored workspace settings. A person writes and reviews this file; its generated counterpart is open-forge.lock.json. Unknown keys are accepted and ignored, so a file written for a newer release stays usable by an older one.

$schema.description: The schema describing this file. Used by editors for completion and validation; never fetched by the CLI.

schemaVersion.description: The shape this file was written for. A version the CLI does not recognise is read for the keys it understands and reported, never refused.

allowInstallPaths.description: Destinations outside .agents that the six permission-gated commands may write to: extension install, remove, and update, and library attach, detach, and sync. Entries are paths, not patterns. An entry naming a file admits that file; an entry naming a directory admits everything beneath it. There is no glob language, so what an entry admits is visible by reading it.

items.description: A workspace-relative path to a file or directory.

removedCategories.description: Canonical root category names under .agents that were deliberately removed. Install and update do not reinstate them.

removedFiles.description: Exact canonical workspace-relative file paths deliberately removed from this workspace. Install and update do not restore or modify these destinations. Paths use forward slashes and cannot name the workspace root, Git metadata, settings, or ownership controls. Globs and recursive directory semantics are not supported. Remove an entry explicitly to allow a later install or update to restore that destination.

items.description: One canonical workspace-relative file path using forward slashes.

removedDirectories.description: Canonical workspace-relative directories deliberately removed from this workspace. Each entry excludes the directory itself and every descendant, including files created later. Install and update do not restore or modify those destinations. The workspace root, Git metadata, settings, and ownership controls are reserved. Remove an entry explicitly to allow a later install or update to restore that directory.

items.description: One canonical workspace-relative directory path using forward slashes, without a trailing slash.

removedExtensions.description: Stable Extension IDs deliberately removed from this workspace. Install, update, and dependency resolution do not reinstall an excluded Extension. Remove an entry explicitly to allow a later install or update.

removedLibraries.description: Stable local Library IDs deliberately detached from this workspace. Attach and sync do not restore an excluded Library. Remove an entry explicitly to allow a later attach or sync.
